steps.acceptance: Each swept directory has a nested options file enabling public_member_api_docs and passes dart analyze --fatal-infos with zero infos of any kind

steps.acceptance: A tool/ script rejects ignore_for_file: public_member_api_docs and any ignore without a same-line reason, reports ignores per directory, and has a test with a positive control

steps.name: Blocking pre-commit hook and installer
steps.acceptance: The committed hook runs the Dart doc linter on changed lines, the ignore checker, and dart analyze --fatal-infos on each swept directory the commit touches, and blocks on any failure

steps.name: CI step per swept directory
steps.acceptance: CI runs flutter analyze --fatal-infos lib/<directory> for every swept directory

steps.name: Scratch-clone demonstration of the gates
steps.acceptance: In a scratch clone that is never pushed and is deleted afterwards, an undocumented public member added to a swept directory is refused by the hook and fails the CI command, both exit codes are recorded, and coverage has not regressed
